esp32.detail: 4 pins wired; PMS3003 particulate matter (PM2.5) sensor needs at least 4.75 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.TXD → RX2 (the board's RX), RXD → TX2 (the board's TX). Added the pms3003.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the PM1.0, PM2.5 and PM10 set on the sliders: passes

pico.detail: 4 pins wired; PMS3003 particulate matter (PM2.5) sensor needs at least 4.75 V, so it is powered from 5 V. U2.TXD → GP1 (the board's RX), RXD → GP0 (the board's TX). Added the pms3003.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the PM1.0, PM2.5 and PM10 set on the sliders: passes
